svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 59 mm of 8 mm bright steel bar; chamfer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end 1 mm so it finds the hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head: a steel washer 18 mm across, 8 mm thick (or two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: washers), pinned or glued on the other end; or buy a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ready-made 8 mm locking pin about 67 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lanyard: 300 mm of stainless wire rope with crimped loops,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the head to an eye screw on the upright's outer face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push it in from outside the stand, through the slot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the upright, the slot in the axle plate and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fan hole that shows in the slot; its tip ends flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the fan's inner face. Pull it out to re-aim the dish.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it slides in and out by hand at every aim.
